scope: Durable utility descriptions for selected deterministic minigame shop results. Ownership, equipped state, current balances, transactions, charges, collection-log state, and all activity outputs remain explicit observations until supported by a later observation and action wave.

records.name: Barbarian Assault durable selected shop utilities

fighter_torso.effect: A Defence-40 melee body item. Its collection-log state and any clue-show use are independently observed.

role_levels.effect: Role levels are persistent Barbarian Assault role capabilities. All four level-5 roles are a separately observed prerequisite for the Kandarin elite blackboard task; they do not claim the diary tier.

records.name: Mahogany Homes durable selected shop utilities

plank_sack.effect: Reusable storage for up to 28 planks; ownership and its actual contents are observed.

amys_saw.effect: Equipable or wieldable Construction saw that can occupy the off-hand. It does not provide the crystal saw's invisible Construction boost.

carpenters_outfit.boundary: Piece ownership and worn state are separate observations; no XP output is calculated.

hosidius_blueprints.effect: Permanently unlocks the Hosidius Wall Kit in the player-owned house.

records.name: Nightmare Zone durable selected shop utilities

imbued_black_mask_or_slayer_helmet.effect: An NMZ imbue upgrades a separately observed eligible base item. Its on-task combat application is not inferred from ownership or a planned task.

imbued_salve.effect: An NMZ-origin Salve imbue upgrades a separately observed eligible Salve item. Only this confirmed origin can satisfy the Ardougne elite diary's Salve requirement; that task and diary claim remain separate observations.

imbued_rings.effect: Each selected exact shop row upgrades only its separately observed base ring. Equipping, combat effect, loss, reversal, and any later re-imbue are outside W2.

scroll_of_redirection.effect: A deterministic stackable transport-planning input. Its actual tablet conversion and transport use remain owned by the existing transport model.

records.name: Pest Control durable selected shop utilities

regular_void_set.effect: The top, robe, gloves, and one combat helmet form a regular Void set only when the required observed pieces are worn. W2 does not infer possession, equipment state, or combat modifiers.

elite_void_top_and_robe.effect: Each confirmed upgrade transforms its observed regular counterpart after the separately observed Western Provinces hard diary claim. The resulting item continues to count as Void gear; wear state and combat effect remain observed.

records.name: Hallowed Sepulchre durable selected shop utilities

hallowed_grapple.effect: Guarantees pillar grapples inside the Sepulchre and can be stored with the Mysterious Stranger.

hallowed_focus.effect: Guarantees and speeds Portal Frame conjuring inside the Sepulchre and can be stored with the Mysterious Stranger.

hallowed_symbol.effect: Halves Saradomin Brazier sacrifices and speeds Holy-barrier passage inside the Sepulchre; it can be stored with the Mysterious Stranger.

hallowed_hammer.effect: Prevents nail breakage while repairing Sepulchre broken bridges and can be stored with the Mysterious Stranger.

hallowed_ring.effect: Prevents direct Sepulchre trap damage and reduces trap-failure time penalty; it can be stored with the Mysterious Stranger.

private_instance.effect: A one-time 200-mark unlock makes a private Sepulchre instance available. Current instance selection, attempt state, and performance remain observed.
